calls.title: Microfoundations of International Business: Integrating Insights from Human Resource Management and Organizational Behavior
calls.summary: JIBS special issue integrating human resource management and organizational behavior insights into microfoundational theorizing about international business; welcomes conceptual, empirical, multilevel, and mixed-method papers. Submission window 16-30 November 2026.

calls.title: AI, Data, and Multinational Enterprises in a Multipolar World
calls.summary: Journal of International Business Studies special issue call on artificial intelligence, data, and multinational enterprises in an increasingly multipolar geopolitical/economic environment; submission window runs 15-30 September 2027.

calls.title: The Dark Sides of Digital Communication
calls.summary: JMS special issue examining the negative/unintended consequences of digital communication for organizations and management, guest-edited by Meurer, Honecker, Waldkirch, and Chalmers; submission window closes September 30, 2026.

calls.title: Board Dynamics in Complex Times
calls.summary: JMS special issue on corporate board dynamics amid complexity/turbulence, guest-edited by Khapova, Krause, Withers, and Zattoni (JMS editor Dimitrios Georgakakis); submissions due February 28, 2027, with an in-person revision workshop planned for Summer 2027.

calls.title: Organizing Truth in an Age of Polarization and Artificial Intelligence
calls.summary: JMS special issue on how truth, credibility, and legitimacy are contested and constructed in and around organizations amid political polarization and AI; submissions due May 3, 2027.

calls.title: Special Call: Qualitative Research Proposals
calls.deadline_text: Rolling/ongoing special call; sources give conflicting proposal deadlines (June 2, 2026 per the SAGE PDF filename/date vs. January 15, 2027 per an AOM community post)
calls.summary: JOM's ongoing Special Call invites proposals (not full papers) for creative/innovative qualitative research, guest-edited by Tima Bansal and Kevin Corley under Editor-in-Chief Cindy Devers; accepted proposals are developed into full papers over an extended, multi-year timeline and published on a rolling basis.

calls.title: AI-Enabled Frontiers in Organizational Science
calls.deadline_text: Stage 1 (3-5 page proposal) due November 1, 2026; Stage 2 is a collaborative development process (Jan-May 2027) including a workshop tentatively scheduled Feb 27-28, 2027
calls.summary: Organization Science special issue seeking theoretically ambitious, phased-review (Stage 1 proposal / Stage 2 development workshop) contributions on how analytic, generative, and agentic AI are reshaping organizational agency and the practice of organizational science itself.

calls.title: AI and Social Science
calls.summary: Organization Science special issue soliciting AI-enabled research loops, reusable research infrastructure, and other fundamentally new forms of social science, run as a three-stage process (proposal/prototype, workshop, finalization) with short Science/Nature-style articles.

calls.title: Agency in the Age of AI
calls.summary: Organization Science special issue examining how AI's growing participation in organizational action, intention, and execution challenges assumptions that agency resides in a single human actor.

calls.title: Qualitative Restudies: Retheorizing in a Changing World
calls.summary: Organization Studies special issue inviting empirical restudies that return to established prior studies/sites to retheorize organizational phenomena; guest editor team is planning restudy method/paper-development workshops including at EGOS 2027. Deadline 31 January 2028.

calls.title: Advancing Systems Perspectives in Organization Studies to Address Social-Ecological Challenges
calls.summary: Organization Studies special issue calling for systems-perspective research on organizations and social-ecological challenges; listed on the journal's official current calls-for-papers page with a deadline of 30 April 2027.

calls.title: The Architecture of Hope in Distressing Times and Places: Construction, Action, and Possibilities
calls.deadline_text: Manuscripts to be submitted between 15 and 30/31 January 2027 (sources vary slightly on exact closing day)
calls.summary: Organization Studies special issue advancing theoretical understanding of hope in organizing amid distressing/turbulent times; associated with the 20th OS Summer Workshop (27-30 May 2026, Thessaloniki). Submission window opens 15 January 2027.

calls.title: Emotions, Values and Institutions in Turbulent Times
calls.summary: Organization Studies special issue on the role of emotions and values in institutions during turbulent times; listed on the journal's official current calls-for-papers page with a deadline of 30 September 2027.

calls.title: Embodying Processes
calls.summary: Organization Studies special issue on embodiment and embodying processes in organizational life; listed on the journal's official current calls-for-papers page with a submission deadline of 30 September 2026.

calls.title: The Coevolution of Financial and Technological Innovations
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue examining the interactions and coevolution between financial innovation and technological innovation, providing a forum for interdisciplinary research; submission deadline 30 November 2026.

calls.title: Measuring and Enhancing the Societal Impact of Academic Engagement
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue analysing how the societal impact of academic engagement can be measured and enhanced.

calls.title: China's Innovation and Technology Policy
calls.summary: Research Policy special issue on the evolution, institutions, and trajectory of China's innovation and technology policy; guest edited by a team including Xiaolan Fu and Arie Lewin. Submission deadline 1 June 2027.

calls.title: Entrepreneurial Ecosystems in Contexts of Institutional Uncertainty, Resource Constraints, and Heightened Volatility
calls.deadline_text: Deadline not independently confirmed; aggregated secondary sources place SEJ special-issue deadlines on the SMS call-for-papers hub around April 2027
calls.summary: SEJ special issue seeking to advance understanding of how entrepreneurial ecosystems emerge, evolve, and operate in emerging economies and other non-advanced contexts marked by institutional uncertainty, resource constraints, and heightened volatility (broadening EE research beyond mature, advanced-economy ecosystems). SEJ Supervising Co-Editor: Peter Klein, Baylor University.

calls.title: The Strategic Role of Judgment in Entrepreneurial Ecosystems
calls.summary: SEJ special issue on how judgment is mobilized, organized, and exploited within entrepreneurial ecosystems, including governance mechanisms for cooperation, competition, resource allocation, and innovation.

calls.title: Entrepreneurial Judgment in Ecosystems
calls.summary: SEJ special issue on how entrepreneurial judgment under uncertainty is mobilized, communicated, coordinated, and governed across multiple stakeholders within entrepreneurial ecosystems, moving beyond single-firm/individual-decision-maker framings. Deadline for full paper submissions is March 1, 2027.

calls.title: International Entrepreneurship in an Age of Persistent Disruption
calls.summary: SEJ special issue integrating strategy, international business, entrepreneurship, and innovation literatures to build a coherent research agenda on international entrepreneurship amid persistent global disruption; SEJ Co-Editor Yong Li is supervising. Submission deadline March 31, 2027, with an online paper development workshop for revise-and-resubmits.

calls.title: Building a Science of the Particular: Methods for Strategy's Core Questions
calls.summary: Strategy Science special issue call seeking papers/proposals on new research methods and practices to help strategy research better reach practitioner audiences; guest-edited by Bennett, Goldfarb, Luo, Nelson, and Snyder (Todd Zenger as advisor). Proposals due November 15, 2026, with strongest proposals invited to submit full papers by April 15, 2027 for standard peer review (an author workshop is also planned).

calls.title: Building a Science of the Particular: Methods for Strategy
calls.deadline_text: proposals due December 15, 2026; strongest proposals invited as full paper submissions due April 15, 2027
calls.summary: Strategy Science special issue call for paper proposals on methods for strategy research, advised by Todd Zenger, run as a proposal stage followed by an author workshop and full peer review.
